notes: Searchable database of Google Maps business listings worldwide, refreshed every 30 days. The go-to API for building business datasets and lead lists in bulk: it returns EVERY listing matching the filters (exact total in data.match_count, cursor pagination), cost-effectively. For a live, up-to-the-minute Google Maps lookup of a business use local-business-data instead. /search (GET, or POST with a JSON body for long/multi-value queries and areas), /area-search-by-bounding-box and /area-search-by-radius return data.businesses[], up to 500 per call (limit 1-500); pass the top-level cursor back to get the next page (omitted on the last page; only valid for the exact same query). /business-details takes up to 500 business_ids per call and adds menu, popular_times, business_services, price_tier, photo_tabs. /business-reviews (20 per page, cursor only when limit=20) and /business-photos (cursor; spec allows limit 1-100 but above 10 currently returns 502 UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE, so scrape.js pages 10 at a time) read live from Google Maps. Fields with no value are left out of a record, and search rows often lack rating, review_count, reviews_per_rating and category_ids that /business-details returns for the same business. No emails or social profiles: chain the website field into website-contacts-scraper for contacts. own_slug is set because the OWN gateway serves this API at /local-business-database while the dev-portal id (portal_api_id, used for self-subscribe) is near_realtime_business_data. The RapidAPI listing is private, so use an OpenWeb Ninja ak_ key.
